branch_assignments.rationale: Executable scene-program representation for indoor worlds.
Custom embodied environment generation and evolution.
Action-conditioned world foundation model for physical AI.

paper.title: SceneCode: Editable Indoor Scene Generation using Executable World Programs
paper.data: indoor scene layouts and hierarchical scene-program examples covering generation, reconstruction, and editing
paper.method: hierarchical executable scene program that decomposes floor plans, rooms, and objects for editable scene generation
paper.task: generate, reconstruct, and edit indoor scenes through executable world programs
paper.novelty: treats indoor scene generation as structured executable program synthesis rather than opaque scene decoding
paper.project_relevance: Strong representation reference for structured world code, room-level decomposition, and local indoor-scene edits.

paper.title: SimWorld Studio: Generation and Evolution of Custom Embodied Agent Learning Environments
paper.data: benchmark suite with 320 embodied tasks and 240 held-out layouts plus generated and evolved environment examples
paper.method: environment generation-and-evolution loop that refines embodied learning worlds from user goals and feedback
paper.task: generate and iteratively evolve custom embodied learning environments
paper.novelty: extends embodied environment generation into an explicit closed-loop evolution process rather than one-shot PCG output
paper.project_relevance: Strong PCG baseline for custom embodied worlds, curriculum generation, and iterative environment refinement.

paper.title: SpatialAct: Probing Spatial Reasoning-to-Action Capabilities of Vision-Language Models in 3D Scenes
paper.data: 333 synthetic 3D scenes and 4,355 QA pairs across three reasoning-to-action task categories
paper.method: 3D-scene benchmark with tool-based repair analysis for spatial reasoning-to-action
paper.task: evaluate whether VLM spatial reasoning is useful for action-grounded decisions in 3D scenes
paper.novelty: bridges spatial QA and action-grounded reasoning with a diagnostic repair stage and 3D benchmark design
paper.project_relevance: Strong validator for action-grounded spatial reasoning in generated or reconstructed worlds.

paper.title: Cosmos-Predict2.5: A World Foundation Model for Physical AI
paper.data: 200 million training video clips and official world-model release artifacts for physical-AI prediction
paper.method: large action-conditioned world foundation model for future physical-scene prediction
paper.task: predict physically meaningful future observations for control, planning, and simulation-like use cases
paper.novelty: positions large-scale predictive world modeling directly as physical-AI infrastructure rather than generic video synthesis
paper.project_relevance: Strong world-model baseline for action-conditioned rollout prediction and control-facing embodied generation.

paper.title: A Unified Evaluation Harness for Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.data: multi-benchmark VLA evaluation adapters, result reporting, and active official repository coverage
paper.method: unified orchestration harness for running VLA models across multiple benchmark suites
paper.task: evaluate VLA models consistently across benchmarks and execution stacks
paper.novelty: standardizes VLA benchmarking infrastructure instead of leaving evaluation fragmented across project-specific scripts
paper.project_relevance: High-value infrastructure reference for evaluation adapters, result schemas, and standardized VLA benchmarking.

paper.title: VLA-REPLICA: A Low-Cost, Reproducible Benchmark for Real-World Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.data: low-cost real-world VLA benchmark setup with 10 tasks, demonstration data, and reproducibility checks across independently built setups
paper.method: standardized physical setup and evaluation protocol for reproducible real-world VLA benchmarking
paper.task: measure VLA performance in a replicable real-world robot setting with ID and OOD evaluation
paper.novelty: prioritizes affordability and cross-site reproducibility in real-world VLA evaluation
paper.project_relevance: Strong real-world evaluation template for low-cost embodied testing and reproducible action-model benchmarking.
